title: Cosmic Shattered Amulet
description: A surreal circular amulet or portal is split into two halves against a dark space background. The left side depicts a starry night sky with glowing orbs and snowy mountains, while the right side shows a cracked mechanical landscape with gears and mossy textures. A golden leaf-shaped key with an all-seeing eye floats in the lower right, emitting a beam of light.
prompt: Surreal cosmic amulet split into two halves floating in dark space with glowing aura. Left side shows deep blue starry night sky with three glowing orbs and snowy mountain peaks. Right side features cracked mechanical terrain with gears, moss, and rusted textures. Central white circular frame holds a cracked globe. Golden leaf key with all-seeing eye hovers in foreground emitting purple light beam. Cracks filled with glowing gold, intricate details, mystical atmosphere.
